Container.Name: ripe
Container.Overview: Read-only, evidence-backed updates for Unraid, Docker and Home Assistant. Stage 1 tracks and explains updates; it never pulls images, executes commands or installs updates. Build ripe:stage1 locally before installing. Notifications start disabled. Review the timezone, LAN binding, Ollama URL and read-only mounts.
Container.Requires: Locally built ripe:stage1 image; NODE2 LAN access; HA long-lived token for HA discovery and optional household notifications; Ollama on NODE2 for classification.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Ripe SQLite database and local cache. The container writes only its own appdata.

Config.Name: Docker socket (read-only mount)
Config.Description: Ripe restricts the Docker client to container/image GET requests. The ro mount alone does not restrict Docker API methods.

Config.Name: Unraid templates (read only)
Config.Description: Only project, icon and WebUI mapping metadata is read. Template environment variables are ignored.

Config.Name: Allowed WebUI hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated WebUI hostnames/IPs, without ports. Change this if NODE2 has a different LAN address. Do not use a wildcard.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Use NODE2's IANA timezone (for example America/New_York). Quiet hours and digest scheduling use this timezone. Editable in Ripe Settings.

Config.Name: Home Assistant URL
Config.Description: Home Assistant on the Raspberry Pi.

Config.Name: Home Assistant token
Config.Description: Long-lived token, entered here securely. Required for update entity discovery and script.notify_household. Never paste it into the UI profile or Git.

Config.Name: Ollama URL on NODE2
Config.Description: Confirm the published port on NODE2. Do not point at the gaming PC. Local profile analysis always uses this service.

Config.Name: Local model
Config.Description: Installed Ollama model name; a 14B model can be selected instead. Ripe does not pull models.

Config.Name: GitHub token (optional)
Config.Description: Optional token for higher public GitHub release API rate limits. No write scopes are needed.

Config.Name: Gemini API key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional public changelog classification or second opinion. Profiles and configs never go to Gemini.

Config.Name: Gemini model
Config.Description: Model identifier; availability and free-tier quotas vary. Gemini is optional and falls back to local.
